caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, circular object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The main composition consists of a large central circle in pale purple and gray tones, decorated with repeating patterns of dots, curved lines, and teardrop shapes arranged in a radial fashion. Surrounding the central circle are ten segments edged with dotted and striped details, each segment terminating in a smaller circle. These smaller circles are similarly colored in pale purple and gray and contain petal-like patterns radiating from their centers. Attached to the bottom of the large central circle is a metallic, gray-shaded mechanical component resembling a latch or clamp, rendered in more solid and darker tones compared to the rest of the design. The overall structure is geometric and decorative, with a clear emphasis on symmetry and pattern using purple, white, and gray hues.
title: Candle Holder
